2. Scope of Work Executed
Industrial Epc works for Trishakti Power Generation Corporation completed 2017.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included expansive clay in the sub-grade requiring
additional treatment. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to the department for
additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of restricted working hours imposed near the
adjoining school. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no
compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the approved
drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all
respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending Engineer.
DOC-CC-033
Page 1 of 3

3. Quality Assessment
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Good. Workmanship was acceptable with minor rework at
two locations, and final inspection was completed in the presence of the client's representative. Materials
were drawn from approved sources and the test results filed with this office were within the limits prescribed
in the contract specification.

5. Deficiency / Observation List
At the time of taking over, minor honeycombing on one abutment face, since made good. Regarding site
safety, one first-aid case was recorded and closed with a toolbox briefing. The agency's conduct during the
contract is recorded as cooperative, with weekly progress reporting maintained without prompting.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2017-09-02. All minor
observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the
inspecting authority.
6. Recommendation
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the joint
measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend release of
the balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified
by V. Mukherjee, Deputy General Manager (Projects).
On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the workmanship
conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does not absolve the contractor of any
obligations under the contract, including the defect liability period.
